commit_message: Remove obsolete MMD scale equivalence test
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up removes the obsolete engine-level test that required PMX import scale to match the removed MMD physics bridge. ADR 0112 intentionally drops the MMD/Bullet runtime-fidelity contract, so restoring that compatibility module would be incorrect.

The PR remains Draft while compatibility aliases, PMX best-effort conversion diagnostics, authoring docs, final Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are completed.
